method_notes: Waltham Forest community and VC school criteria (Starting Primary School 2027 brochure, Section 1, pp11-13): distance is measured in a straight line from the centre of the child's permanent address, as defined by the Local Land and Property Gazetteer, to the designated main gate of the school. Measurement uses the RouteFinder GIS system, in miles. In multi-occupancy buildings the lowest door number takes priority; remaining ties go to a lottery drawn by an impartial officer. Barclay, Mission Grove and Hillyfield are split-site schools: both sites are measured and the shorter distance used. Several academies adopt the LA criteria (Barclay, Davies Lane, George Mitchell, Hillyfield, Mayville, Riverley, Roger Ascham, Selwyn, Sybourn, Thomas Gamuel, Willow Brook, Woodford Green, Yardley). Exceptions: Lime Academy Larkswood measures the walking route on AA route planner to the main gate. Buxton School measures straight line to its Woodhouse Road main gate. The United Learning Trust schools (Salisbury Manor, Longshaw, Whittingham, Walthamstow Primary Academy), Woodside (REAch2), Emmanuel (free school) and the Catholic/CofE schools have their own criteria. Where the brochure states their method it is straight line to the main gate.

gaps: The 2026 figures come from the detailed offer-day table, not the 3-year summary. The two disagree for three schools: Gwyn Jones (table n/a with 12 places left; summary 0.517), Parkside (table n/a with 9 left; summary 1.513, the same as its 2023 figure) and Willow Brook (table 0.515; summary 0.525). The detailed table was used. The 2025 figures come only from the 2025/26 column of the 3-year table: the Starting Primary School 2026 brochure, which holds the detailed 2025 table, was not found online. Blank cells mean 'all on-time applicants were offered this school or a higher preference' and are recorded as all_offered. Dawlish 2026 and St Joseph's Infant 2026 were full but show no cut-off, so they are also all_offered. Oakhill 2024 printed 5.772 miles (kept as printed). St Mary's CofE 2026 (0.305) was a multiple-birth case. PAN is the 2026 PAN from the offer-day table. The criteria of the ULT schools, Woodside, Emmanuel and the faith schools were not read in full, so their method is assumed straight line where not stated. Junior schools (Chapel End Junior Academy, St Joseph's Catholic Junior) are excluded.
